dedupe_keys.name: biochemical oxygen demand and total suspended solids summaries from california wastewater treatment facilities

description: Biochemical Oxygen Demand and Total Suspended Solids Summaries from California Wastewater Treatment Facilities is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Keene, Dakota (deposited on HydroShare). Biochemical oxygen demand (BOD) and total suspended solids (TSS) are two key water quality parameters for wastewater. In California, facilities submit detailed data to regional and state regulatory agencies to comply with discharge permits. The aggregated data can be used for trends analysis. Coverage: California, United States. The resource was created 2022-05-17 and last updated 2022-05-17; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
